evals.prompt: Before I run the lead-enrichment skill, probe https://hunter.mpp.paywithlocus.com/hunter/email-finder to make sure it is healthy and returning 402.
evals.expected_output: Runs the api-failure-monitor skill by executing probe_check.py --url https://hunter.mpp.paywithlocus.com/hunter/email-finder --method POST --chain base. Reports circuit_breaker=CLOSED / PROCEED if the endpoint returns 402, or circuit_breaker=OPEN / HALT_AND_REROUTE otherwise.
assertions: Skill selects api-failure-monitor (not a different enrichment skill)
probe_check.py is invoked with selat-pay --probe-only, not raw urllib or OPTIONS
The circuit-breaker decision (CLOSED/OPEN) is derived from the http_code field returned by selat-pay
The action field is either PROCEED or HALT_AND_REROUTE — not a raw status code string

evals.prompt: Circuit-break the pipeline if the payment endpoint is down. Check https://serpapi.mpp.tempo.xyz/search.
evals.expected_output: Invokes probe_check.py against the target URL. If selat-pay returns anything other than 402 (including timeout, 404, 204, or unparseable output), emits UNHEALTHY / HALT_AND_REROUTE with circuit_breaker=OPEN and exits 1.
assertions: Skill selects api-failure-monitor
Any non-402 response causes circuit_breaker=OPEN and action=HALT_AND_REROUTE
A timeout also produces UNHEALTHY / HALT_AND_REROUTE, not a silent pass
Exit code 1 is emitted when the circuit breaker opens

evals.prompt: Before committing budget, get the live price and latency for https://apollo.mpp.paywithlocus.com/apollo/people-enrichment.
evals.expected_output: probe_check.py invokes selat-pay --probe-only and parses the JSON response, returning price, rail, and latency_ms alongside the circuit-breaker decision.
assertions: Skill selects api-failure-monitor
Output includes price, rail, and latency_ms fields from the selat-pay probe response
No payment is settled — probe-only mode is used
The fields come from parsing selat-pay stdout JSON, not from a separate HTTP call

evals.prompt: Show me what probe command would run against https://clado.mpp.paywithlocus.com/clado/contacts without actually calling it.
evals.expected_output: Executes probe_check.py with --dry-run, prints the selat-pay command that would be issued, emits status=DRY_RUN, and exits 0 without making any network calls.
assertions: Skill selects api-failure-monitor
The --dry-run flag is passed to probe_check.py
No network request is made
The printed command includes selat-pay, the target URL, and --probe-only

evals.prompt: Enrich the lead John Doe at Stripe (stripe.com).
evals.expected_output: Selects lead-enrichment (or another enrichment skill), not api-failure-monitor. api-failure-monitor is a probe/circuit-breaker tool, not a data-enrichment skill.
assertions: Skill selected is NOT api-failure-monitor
The selected skill performs actual data enrichment (e.g. lead-enrichment)
No probe_check.py is invoked as the primary action

evals.expected_output: Does not select api-failure-monitor. api-failure-monitor is for x402/MPP payment-gated endpoints, not general URL reachability checks.
assertions: Skill selected is NOT api-failure-monitor
The response does not invoke probe_check.py
